cards.front: The tendon containing the patella belongs to the [___] muscle group.
cards.context: The patella is embedded in the quadriceps tendon. Below it, the patellar ligament connects to the tibial tuberosity; the patella improves the extensor mechanism leverage.

cards.front: The lateral rectus is supplied by which cranial nerve? [___]
cards.context: The lateral rectus is the horizontal muscle that moves the eye away from the nose. Its motor supply is from cranial nerve VI.
